summary.title: Campus Event Portal
summary.description: Threat modeling for event management system

threats.title: Broken Authentication & Session Hijacking
threats.description: User authentication gagal (credential stuffing, session hijack via cookie/JWT)
threats.mitigation:
MFA
bcrypt password hashing
JWT short-lived + refresh token
Secure cookies
Account lockout

threats.title: Email Phishing (Notification Spoofing)
threats.mitigation:
SPF / DKIM / DMARC
Email allowlist
Block redirect URL

threats.title: Stored XSS (Comment System)
threats.description: Komentar user disimpan lalu dirender → XSS

threats.title: Security Misconfiguration
threats.description: Error message terlalu detail, admin path terbuka
threats.mitigation:
Generic error message
Hide stack trace
Security headers
Protect admin route

threats.title: SQL Injection (Registration Form)
threats.description: Input field tidak divalidasi → SQL Injection
threats.mitigation:
Prepared statement
ORM
Input validation
Least privilege DB
